name: Roasted coffee
definition: roasted coffee beans sold whole or ground (grind an attribute), including drip bags (a pack form).

name: Green (unroasted) coffee
definition: raw, unroasted coffee beans sold to roast.

name: Instant coffee
definition: soluble dried coffee extract, including a dry mix whose largest ingredient by weight is coffee (attribute `mix`, K-49).

name: Coffee capsule or pod (machine system)
definition: single-serve capsule, E.S.E. pod or paper pad of coffee made for one machine system (system in the C13 ledger).

name: Liquid coffee concentrate
definition: liquid coffee extract sold to dilute, coffee its main ingredient; a sweetened or milk ready-to-drink is OUT (J6-O1).

name: White tea
definition: Camellia sinensis buds or young leaves withered and dried with little processing.

name: Steamed green tea
definition: unoxidised tea fixed by steaming, rolled and dried (sencha, bancha).

name: Shade-grown steamed green tea
definition: green tea from bushes shaded before harvest, then steamed (gyokuro).

name: Pan-fired green tea
definition: unoxidised tea fixed by heating in a pan or drum (Long Jing, Bi Luo Chun).

name: Roasted green tea
definition: green tea roasted after fixing (hojicha).

name: Powdered green tea (matcha)
definition: shade-grown, steamed, unrolled tea leaf stone-ground to a fine powder.

name: Yellow tea
definition: green-processed tea given a slow sealed yellowing step before drying.

name: Oolong tea
definition: partly oxidised tea, bruised and rolled between withering and fixing.

name: Black tea (orthodox or CTC)
definition: fully oxidised tea, made orthodox or by CTC (leaf grade an attribute).

name: Pu-erh tea
definition: post-fermented Yunnan large-leaf tea, raw (sheng) or ripe (shou), loose or pressed into cakes, tuo cha or bricks (attributes). Level provisional until attested (R-19).

name: Other dark tea
definition: post-fermented tea other than pu-erh (Liu Bao, Liu'an).

name: Scented, flavoured and blended tea
definition: tea of any base type scented, flavoured or blended with other ingredients (Earl Grey, jasmine tea, blooming tea, genmaicha).

name: Spiced tea blend (chai)
definition: tea blended with spices to brew as chai.

name: Cocoa beans
definition: whole cacao beans, raw, fermented and dried, or roasted.

name: Cocoa nibs
definition: cocoa beans cracked and shelled into pieces, raw or roasted.

name: Cocoa shells and husks
definition: the shell of the cocoa bean, sold for infusion.

name: Cocoa paste or mass
definition: ground cocoa nibs set in a block or drops (cocoa liquor, ceremonial cacao); couverture and baking chocolate are J5 (K-50).

name: Cocoa butter
definition: the fat pressed from cocoa paste (K-50).

name: Cocoa powder
definition: unsweetened powder of pressed cocoa solids, natural, Dutch-process or black (alkalisation and fat content attributes).

name: Drinking chocolate powder
definition: sweetened cocoa powder for a drink, cocoa its largest ingredient by weight; a sugar-led mix is OUT (K-49).

name: Lemon verbena
definition: dried lemon verbena leaves sold for infusion.

name: Peppermint
definition: dried peppermint leaves sold for infusion.

name: Rooibos
definition: dried, usually oxidised leaves and stems of Aspalathus linearis sold for infusion. Level provisional until attested (R-19).

name: Yerba mate
definition: dried, usually aged leaves and stems of Ilex paraguariensis sold for infusion (con palo, despalada, chimarrão, barbacuá). Level provisional until attested (R-19).

name: Chamomile
definition: dried chamomile flowers sold for infusion.

name: Elderflower
definition: dried elder flowers sold for infusion.

name: Hibiscus
definition: dried hibiscus calyces and petals sold for infusion.

name: Lavender
definition: dried lavender flowers sold for infusion.

name: Fruit tea (dried-fruit blend)
definition: blend of dried fruit pieces sold for infusion.

name: Rose hip
definition: dried rose hips sold for infusion.

name: Ginger
definition: dried ginger root sold for infusion (in a jar as a cooking spice it is J5).

name: Kava (root powder)
definition: ground root of Piper methysticum sold to prepare as a drink. Level provisional until attested (R-19).

name: Roasted chicory root (coffee substitute)
definition: roasted chicory root sold to brew as a coffee substitute (K-51).

name: Turmeric
definition: dried turmeric root sold for infusion (in a jar as a cooking spice it is J5).

name: Roasted barley tea
definition: roasted barley grains sold to brew (K-51).

name: Herbal blend
definition: blend of infusion plants from more than one plant part, none of which makes up half or more of its weight (final kind, K-46).
